sentences.en: Kaplan University is an online college granting associate's, bachelor's, and master's degrees in many fields, from nursing, to education, to business.

sentences.en: Kaplan University has grown significantly over the years, and now educates more than 48,000 enrolled students.

sentences.en: As online education has grown, Kaplan has become one of the leading names in online education.

sentences.en: Kaplan also has a small traditional division of the university, with a main campus in Davenport, Iowa.

sentences.en: This option of studying either online or at a physical university campus is another attractive aspect of Kaplan University.
